name: MAHJONG BATTLE HEROINES
original_name: 麻雀BATTLE HEROINES ～バトルヒロインズ～
source:
In a futuristic setting, the invention of ultra-high-performance shock-absorbing suits allowed people to fight safer during fighting tournaments.

The fact that even women were not at risk of injury spread, and with media coverage, it developed into a massive entertainment industry. 

It was an event reminiscent of Roman times, but it was embraced by many seeking thrills.

Marketed as an "extreme yet safe sport", it became increasingly visually oriented, giving rise to fighting idols and other such figures.

However, evil people exist in every era.

Those in power, seeking more extreme thrills and to satisfy their desires, and those in the underworld, seeking enormous profits...

The protagonist, Makoto, the winner of the student tournament, has her sister taken hostage and is forced to participate in an underground tournament...

[Edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/850403/]Getchu[/url]]
